name: Ruben Choi
life: “I still remember building doll chairs from an old school desk.” Saturday often includes a stop at the market by Market Flats, where Ruben often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I wanted the wood for toys. The owner asked me to make one chair small enough for her new kitchen.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a cream pullover and a train token tied to a zipper pull. Ruben has an aquiline nose and a square chin, with black hair twisted into a small knot. Ruben listens with the head tilted a little to the left during a conversation.
personality: Ruben is fond of ambitious ideas and deeply suspicious of grand openings. The question Ruben asks at any launch is who has the keys for cleaning up a month later.
agenda: To build one small kitchen chair from the old stock.
family: Grey Clement is Ruben’s half-sibling. Ruben makes the call. Grey is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *Winter afloat*, Grey says, “I found an old lease with a shore room included.”
connections: Talia Bloom. A childhood repair and a new small chair make different use of the same rung. Also in the story is Logan Walker (cushion restorer).

reactions.situation: A repair reveals a family name under the cushion
reactions.response: Ruben invites the family to see the full name before the repair is closed.
reactions.asWritten: A repair reveals a family name under the cushion. Ruben invites the family to see the full name before the repair is closed.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Ruben offers to walk to the next staffed place together, at the stranger's pace, to ask about another ride.

reactions.response: Ruben accepts only after finding out whether the person doing the regular work can come too.
reactions.asWritten: If offered a ceremonial role, Ruben accepts only after finding out whether the person doing the regular work can come too.
